method: Season the paneer well and fry in a hot pan with a little oil for 3-4 minutes each side.
Lift out to rest, add the Honey Mustard to the pan and let it bubble into a sauce, then return the paneer to coat.
Serve with the red onion and green beans and a green salad.

name: Char Siu Tofu Noodles
blurb: Char Siu tofu with leeks, served with noodles.
method: Cook the noodles to packet instructions, then drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the tofu and leeks, add the Char Siu and the noodles and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve straight away with extra chilli, lime or sesame.

name: Chilli-Lime Halloumi Traybake
blurb: A chilli-lime traybake of halloumi with green beans, fennel.
method: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Tip the Halloumi, green beans and fennel and Chilli-Lime into a large roasting tin with oil and seasoning and toss.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until the halloumi is cooked through and everything is golden at the edges.
Serve straight from the tin with potatoes.

name: Salmoriglio Chickpea Skillet
blurb: A salmoriglio skillet of chickpea with mangetout, red onion.

Add the mangetout and red onion, then stir in the Salmoriglio with a splash of water and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce clings.
Check the seasoning and serve with rice.

name: Harissa Pork Loin Skewers
blurb: Harissa pork loin with chestnut mushrooms, served with rice.
method: Toss the pork loin in the Harissa and leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes.
